claim_boundary.claim_if_null: Stage 27F neuron-cover causality remains valid, but direct amplification of those covers did not establish readout-level steering under the preregistered controls.
claim_boundary.claim_if_pass: Within Pythia-160M and the trained Stage 7 Foundation readout, amplifying class-specific Stage 27F MLP-neuron covers increases target-vs-hard-partner margins, while polarity-flipping those same covers decreases those margins, both above matched random neuron-cover controls.
claim_boundary.forbidden_claims: Do not claim free-form generation control, model-wide control, complete circuits, weight editing, internal CAS compiler behavior, cross-model steering, or raw CAS-symbol understanding from Stage 27G.
claim_boundary.scope_boundary: Stage 27G is readout-level steering evidence over Stage 27F MLP-neuron covers. It is not free-form generation control, not weight editing, not a complete circuit, not model-wide control, and not a claim that raw CAS symbols are understood.

formal_anchor: Intervention surface refinement: Stage 27F identifies causal neuron covers; Stage 27G tests directional control by amplifying and polarity-flipping those covers, then measuring the signed readout-margin response.

gates.criterion: Stage 7 activation artifact hash matches the locked manifest.
gates.name: artifact_contract

gates.criterion: Stage 27F source report is PASS and exposes per-class MLP-neuron covers.
gates.name: stage27f_contract

gates.criterion: Target-cover amplification beats random target-layer amplification on at least 60% of eval rows with sign-test p<0.05.
gates.name: target_amplification_control

gates.criterion: Target-cover polarity flip reduces target-vs-partner margin more than random target-layer polarity flips on at least 60% of eval rows with sign-test p<0.05.
gates.name: target_polarity_flip_control

gates.criterion: Both target-amplification margin increases and target-flip margin reductions are positive on at least 55% of eval rows.
gates.name: bidirectional_positive_share

gates.criterion: Report the share of rows where target polarity flip and partner amplification push target-vs-partner margin below zero; not required for PASS.
gates.name: flip_share

method: Commit this pre-registration and runner before any Stage 27G GPU result is generated.
Refit the locked Stage 7 28-way Foundation probe on the locked layer-6 focus-token artifact.
Verify Stage 27F is PASS, uses the locked artifact, and exposes per-class MLP-neuron covers.
On held-out Stage 7 test rows, read the target Foundation and hard-partner Foundation for each row.
Amplify the target class's Stage 27F neuron cover by the preregistered scale and measure target-vs-partner margin increase.
Polarity-flip the same target class neuron cover by the preregistered negative scale and measure target-vs-partner margin decrease or sign flip.
Compare both directional effects against same-size/same-layer random neuron-cover controls using the same intervention scale.
Amplify the hard-partner class's cover as a countersteering diagnostic, but do not use it as the primary PASS gate because the partner cover may be inactive on target-class prompts.
Report actual margin-flip share for polarity flip and partner amplification as diagnostics; signed readout-margin steering is the primary gate.
motivation: Stage 27F established sparse MLP-neuron covers that causally support class-specific Foundation margins. Stage 27G tests whether those same covers can steer the readout when amplified.
